verdict.rationale: BVNK documents general programmatic wallet creation (crypto/fiat) via API/Portal and Hawk-based API authentication, and a probe references an 'agent-wallet-cli' repo, suggesting some agent-oriented wallet tooling exists. However there is no documentation of scoped API keys per agent, policy/permission controls, or explicit spending/movement limits tailored to autonomous agents. Missing for 10: scoped-key issuance mechanics, policy engine/spend-limit configuration, and agent-specific governance documentation.
